styles.name: Neutral collage
styles.description: Quiet conceptual editorial collage: grayscale hero cutout, one accent color.
styles.promptSuffix: . Render this as a conceptual editorial collage illustration about the subject above, with a restrained, contemporary aesthetic. Style & composition: a neutral-toned flat background (soft gray, desaturated beige, or muted off-white) with subtle grain texture reminiscent of risograph or analog print; avoid tonal bias, especially yellow or blue. Feature one hero photographic cutout in grayscale, supported by one or two smaller photographic or silhouetted cutouts that subtly set the scene or mood (atmospheric, not literal). Prioritize negative space, asymmetry, and off-grid placement to evoke tension, imbalance, or editorial hierarchy; avoid static centering or decorative symmetry. Symbolic line-work: minimal, hand-drawn micro-line details that interact meaningfully with the subject, suggesting direction or flow, collaboration (intertwined, crossed-out, looped around), friction or tension, or abstract conceptual cues (imbalance, pressure, silence); no decorative scribbles or ornamental marks. Color: choose a single accent color from the subject's thematic meaning (color psychology), applied in exactly one way, either an overlaid color-wipe on one element, the color of the line-work, or one supporting storytelling color detail; keep it editorial, not expressive. Focus on symbolic abstraction over direct representation; no logos, branding, or literal iconography; do not show people, body parts, or silhouettes unless fully abstracted. Avoid vector styles, geometric overlays, dramatized emotion, and decorative elements that do not serve the metaphor. Overall tone: visually quiet, conceptually sharp, editorially neutral, evoking inquiry rather than answers. No text or words.

styles.name: Editorial collage
styles.description: Warm, minimal editorial collage on oat with a soft 3–5 color palette.
styles.promptSuffix: . Render this as a refined editorial collage about the subject above. Visual construction: 3 to 8 elements maximum; crisp photographic cut-outs with clean masked edges (no torn edges), shot on a film camera, black-and-white or color; arranged asymmetrically with strong hierarchy and large negative space; intentional and designed, never busy or decorative; when people are depicted, prioritize diversity. Graphic details: very minimal fine marks only, such as thin line or diagram connectors (no arrows) and small scribbles, kept subtle and secondary. Color: a warm, human-centered palette of 3 to 5 colors total on a bright off-white oat background; allowed tones include sage, moss, eucalyptus, oat, sand, almond, parchment, clay, powder blue, faded sky, dusty teal, apricot, soft coral, terracotta, marigold, cocoa, graphite; colors softly lit and naturally balanced. Strict exclusions: no neon, no pure primaries, no pure black, no strong color contrast, no vector graphics or iconography (squares, triangles, circles). Surface: subtle paper grain, no gloss, no shine, no heavy texture. Mood: refined, minimal, conceptual, editorial, calm. Do not include clutter, drop shadows, torn edges, thick outlines, decorative graphics, harsh lighting, busy layouts, oversaturation, or text/words.

styles.name: Retro print
styles.description: Vintage risograph / newsprint halftone: grayscale cut-outs with a single retro accent color.
styles.promptSuffix: . Render this as a retro, vintage print illustration of the subject above, in the spirit of mid-century risograph and newsprint halftone. Use a flat off-white, cream, or light warm-gray background with heavy analog grain and stippled, engraved, or dotted halftone texture. Render the subject as monochrome grayscale photographic cut-outs and fine stipple or engraving illustrations with clean masked edges. Apply exactly ONE saturated retro accent color (for example a single classic red, warm orange, or muted vintage green) used sparingly, as one small element, a thin line, a border, or a single color-blocked shape, so it pops against the muted grayscale. Add thin, hand-drawn ink line-work such as wavy connectors, looping flourishes, or small scribbles (no arrows), kept subtle and secondary. Compose with strong negative space, asymmetry, and intentional editorial hierarchy reminiscent of a vintage instruction manual, an old software interface, or a printed poster. Optional minimal vintage typographic labels in a clean monospace or grotesque typeface may appear sparingly as part of the layout. Mood: nostalgic, analog, restrained, and quietly playful. Avoid glossy gradients, neon, drop shadows, 3D realism, busy clutter, and oversaturation.

styles.name: Flat tutorial
styles.description: Bold flat-vector mascots in a bright, friendly app-tutorial style.
styles.promptSuffix: . Render this as a bold, flat vector illustration of the subject above, in the friendly style of a modern app tutorial or onboarding mascot. Use clean solid color fills with no gradients and no realistic lighting; flat two-tone shading at most. Build forms from simple, rounded geometric shapes with chunky, exaggerated proportions and smooth rounded corners. Keep characters and objects approachable and expressive, with minimal facial features (simple dot eyes, clean smiles) and clear, playful poses; when characters are shown, depict a diverse and inclusive cast. Place the subject on a clean flat background, either plain white or a single soft pastel color, with generous space and an optional soft flat drop-shadow ellipse beneath it. Use a bright, cheerful, saturated palette (purples, pinks, greens, blues, reds, yellows, oranges) that stays balanced and harmonious, never muddy. Keep edges crisp and clean with minimal or no outlines, and no photographic texture, no grain, no 3D, no gradients, and no busy detail. Mood: friendly, energetic, clear, and welcoming, like a learning-app character set.
